Reviewed PR #22 (base 96a6dca → head 1069d4c): complete immutable diff of 58 files / 82 chunks, all pages read and assessed — append-only receipts and session-mycology ledger appends, ~40 archived review-evidence JSONs (PR22/136/386 bot reviews, proxx/knoxx runtime observations), 14 kanban planning cards across the always-on and character epics, two operator/verification notes plus a 603-line operational evidence report, one additive CI gate, and the new read-only diagnostic `scripts/verify_cephalon_local.cljs` with its fixture suite `test/verify_cephalon_local_test.cljs`.

Deterministic evidence: 13/13 gates exit 0 at exact head on a clean checkout (workspace 24/120, cephalon_diagnostic 12/93, project/lineage/evidence laws, contracts, migration pack, receipt history, diff hygiene); opencode/jscpd ENOENT lines are isolated-runner tool absences, not change-introduced failures.

Confirmed findings: none. Three low-severity candidates were registered and all rejected under adversarial validation: (1) the `:end-run-tests` exit hook is the exact extension nbb's bundled cljs.test documents and is already used by five pre-existing suites whose gates catch red fixtures; (2) mixed scalar/array `dependency:` frontmatter is pre-existing corpus convention (unchanged cc1/cc2 cards use arrays), no repo gate parses kanban frontmatter (all 13 gates green), the installed Rheos loader's metadata drop is disclosed and tracked upstream (rheos#3), and no card claims admission; (3) the diagnostic's "Failures: N" equals the printed FAIL lines on every path (throw paths print a second FAIL line from the -main catch) with the correct exit status, pinned by exact-count test assertions. Independently verified that all three archived CodeRabbit findings (destination access-policy + negative no-write tests, b5f2ba9e predecessor in the physical-field dependency array, 7-vs-8 WARN labeling) are addressed in current content and honestly labeled as planning criteria with runtime guarantees still unimplemented; card UUID cross-references, dependency orientations, and point arithmetic (24/21 vs frontmatter 16; 34+3=37 vs frontmatter 34; 10×3+1+5=36min cycle budget) are internally consistent with no status, transition, or frontmatter-points changes.

Non-blocking notes: the spawnSync-nonzero / docker-exec-inner-failure paths are only indirectly fixture-covered (test gap without a demonstrated regression); archived bot approvals in the diff bind historical heads and were not treated as current evidence; absolute host paths in planning notes are provenance references only.
